description:
Turn one sermon into material a small group can work through. Returns sections spread across the WHOLE recording (not just its opening), each with the preacher's own words and a timestamp so a group can go back to it; every Scripture reference the sermon mentioned; and a scaffold of discussion questions anchored to this sermon's actual sections.
YOU write the final guide. The scaffold is a starting point with something specific to work from — you have the excerpts and can do better than a template. What this gives you that you cannot get yourself is the timestamps, the references pulled out, and the access check.
VERIFY every reference with verify_scripture before quoting it. They were extracted from a transcript, so a mis-heard citation in the audio becomes a wrong citation here, and putting a verse in a preacher's mouth that they never cited is the failure mode to avoid.
Only sermons a church opted in to share are available. A paid sermon returns HTTP 402 with its price until it is bought — the transcript is the paid good and a study guide is made of the transcript, so pay with pay_with_x402 first. Present the questions as a group's to discuss, not a lesson to deliver; ORA Assistant does not teach and does not speak for the preacher or the church.

sections.description: How many sections to pull from the recording.

sermon_id.description: The sermon to build a guide from — a sermon_id from search_sermons or find_churches_preaching_on.
